theorems.name: Submission.rsd_tendsto_ball_density_of_closedBall
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (θ : ℝ≥0∞), Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => ν (closedBall x ρ) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 θ) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => ν (ball x ρ) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 θ)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
